from copy import deepcopy
from svrptw.solvers.common import Solution, evaluate
from svrptw.council.proposal import OperatorContext

def operator(solution: Solution, context: OperatorContext) -> Solution | None:
    inst = context.instance
    deadline = time.perf_counter() + context.deadline_seconds
    routes = [r for r in solution.routes if len(r.customers) >= 3]
    if len(routes) < 2: return None
    loads = [sum(inst.customers[c-1].demand for c in r.customers) for r in routes]
    h_idx, l_idx = max(range(len(loads)), key=loads.__getitem__), min(range(len(loads)), key=loads.__getitem__)
    if h_idx == l_idx or loads[h_idx] < inst.vehicle_capacity * 0.7: return None
    r_h, r_l = routes[h_idx], routes[l_idx]
    for i in range(len(r_h.customers) - 2):
        if time.perf_counter() > deadline: break
        for j in range(len(r_l.customers) - 2):
            new_sol = deepcopy(solution)
            seg = new_sol.routes[h_idx].customers[i:i+3]
            new_sol.routes[h_idx].customers[i:i+3] = new_sol.routes[l_idx].customers[j:j+3]
            new_sol.routes[l_idx].customers[j:j+3] = seg
            new_cost = evaluate(inst, new_sol, context.settings)
            if new_cost < solution.metrics['operational_cost']:
                return new_sol
    return None

    custs = _cust_by_id(inst)

    centroids = {}

        dists = [np.linalg.norm(np.array(coords[c]) - centroids[ri]) for c in r.customers]

        for target_ri, centroid in centroids.items():

            if target_ri == ri: continue
            new_routes = [list(r.customers) for r in solution.routes]
